paths.name: Hero's Path
paths.description: Walk the path of justice and protection. Your choices strengthen your resolve to help others.

paths.name: Anti-Hero's Path
paths.description: A darker road. You do what needs to be done, regardless of moral costs.

paths.name: Villain's Path
paths.description: Embrace darkness. Power through fear and domination.

paths.name: Mercenary's Path
paths.description: True neutral. Gold is your only loyalty.

paths.name: Legend's Path
paths.description: Your deeds will be sung for generations. A path of great achievement.

paths.name: Mythic Path
paths.description: Transcend mortal limitations. Become legend itself.

paths.name: Chaos Path
paths.description: Embrace the unpredictable. Randomness is your ally.

paths.name: Order Path
paths.description: Structure and discipline guide your journey.

paths.name: Shadow Path
paths.description: Walk in darkness. Strike from the unseen.

paths.name: Light Path
paths.description: Radiance guides your way. Purge darkness wherever you go.

choices.title: Defend the Village
choices.description: Bandits attack a small village. You can defend it.
choices.consequenceDescription: The villagers praise your heroism. Word of your deeds spreads.

choices.title: Accept Tribute
choices.description: The village offers you gold to leave them to the bandits.
choices.consequenceDescription: You take the gold and walk away. The bandits pillage the village.

choices.title: Join the Slaughter
choices.description: You can join the bandits in their raid for great plunder.
choices.consequenceDescription: The village burns. You gain wealth but earn a dark reputation.

choices.title: Negotiate Peace
choices.description: You attempt to broker a deal between bandits and villagers.
choices.consequenceDescription: A tense peace is negotiated. Both sides respect your cunning.

choices.title: Give Generously
choices.description: A beggar asks for coin. You give freely.
choices.consequenceDescription: The beggar reveals themselves as a disguised sage and grants you a blessing.

choices.title: Walk Past
choices.description: You ignore the beggar's plea.
choices.consequenceDescription: You continue on your path, focused on your goals.

choices.title: Rob the Beggar
choices.description: The beggar looks wealthy despite their rags. You take what they have.
choices.consequenceDescription: You find a small fortune, but feel the weight of your actions.

choices.title: Offer Employment
choices.description: You offer the beggar work in exchange for pay.
choices.consequenceDescription: The beggar becomes a loyal contact in the underworld.

choices.title: Honorable Duel
choices.description: A warrior challenges you. You accept with honor.
choices.consequenceDescription: A glorious battle. Whether you win or lose, you gain respect.

choices.title: Use Any Means
choices.description: Victory at any cost. You fight dirty.
choices.consequenceDescription: You win, but observers frown upon your tactics.

choices.title: Spare the Boss
choices.description: You defeat a powerful enemy but choose to spare their life.
choices.consequenceDescription: The enemy becomes an ally. A powerful friend in need.

choices.title: Show No Mercy
choices.description: You eliminate the defeated enemy completely.
choices.consequenceDescription: Fear follows your name. No one expects mercy from you.

choices.title: Seek Peace
choices.description: Two factions are at war. You work to broker peace.
choices.consequenceDescription: Your diplomatic success saves countless lives.

choices.title: Fuel the Conflict
choices.description: You supply weapons to both sides, profiting from war.
choices.consequenceDescription: Blood money fills your coffers. Many suffer for your gain.

choices.title: Lead by Example
choices.description: You inspire others through your actions.
choices.consequenceDescription: Followers gather. You become a natural leader.

choices.title: Honest Deal
choices.description: A merchant offers a rigged deal. You refuse.
choices.consequenceDescription: Your reputation as an honest trader spreads far and wide.

choices.title: Swindle the Mark
choices.description: You take advantage of the naive buyer.
choices.consequenceDescription: Quick gold, but your name becomes synonymous with deceit.

choices.title: Invest in Future
choices.description: You invest your gold in a risky venture.
choices.consequenceDescription: Fortune favors the bold. The investment pays off handsomely.

choices.title: Braved the Danger
choices.description: You explore a dangerous ancient ruin.
choices.consequenceDescription: Ancient secrets revealed. Powerful artifacts claimed.

choices.title: Plan Thoroughly
choices.description: You carefully map and plan before exploring.
choices.consequenceDescription: Nothing missed. Every treasure secured with minimal risk.

choices.title: Sacrifice for Knowledge
choices.description: You give up something precious to unlock ancient knowledge.
choices.consequenceDescription: The ancient ones reveal truths beyond mortal comprehension.

choices.title: Uncover the Truth
choices.description: A conspiracy lurks. You investigate despite the danger.
choices.consequenceDescription: The truth is revealed. Evil foiled, but powerful enemies made.

choices.title: Keep the Secrets
choices.description: You discover dark secrets and choose to hide them.
choices.consequenceDescription: You hold dangerous knowledge. Power, but at what cost?

choices.title: Sacrifice the Innocent
choices.description: To stop a greater evil, you must sacrifice one who is innocent.
choices.consequenceDescription: The greater evil is stopped, but your soul grows darker.

choices.title: Trial by Sacrifice
choices.description: A legendary trial requires giving up something dear.
choices.consequenceDescription: Sacrifice begets power. You become legend.

choices.title: Trial by Honor
choices.description: Face a legendary challenge with honor as your only shield.
choices.consequenceDescription: Your honor shines brighter than any blade. Legend awaits.

choices.title: Challenge the Gods
choices.description: Defy the divine and claim godhood.
choices.consequenceDescription: You ascend. Mortality behind you, eternity ahead.

choices.title: Seek Cosmic Truth
choices.description: Abandon all to understand the universe.
choices.consequenceDescription: The cosmos reveals its secrets. You become one with all.
